activation_policy: 90% uniform -365..-1 days; 10% uniform day 0..20; independent of target; all agents established

agent_settings.A1: 4..16 wallets ranked by lowest preceding 30-day service count plus one previously served customer where available
agent_settings.A2: 2..6 designated wallets receive 35..85% of episode event count; other customers fill remainder
agent_settings.A3: 2..4 irregular time clusters within 15..120 minutes; common amount support
agent_settings.A4: Opening three cash events contain 2/3 count dominance and independently varying 60..95% value dominance; later service events may rebalance

baseline_policy: One routine event per wallet after activation, plus ordinary background throughout the horizon; part of 100000 budget
coordination_to_duration: u ** (0.7 + coordination), scaled to family interval; shared complete support
episode_policy: Complete episodes; integer budget packing before materialization; no truncation or model-driven selection
holdout_policy: Software API guards and manifest roles; user-approved replacement of external custody. Not an OS access boundary.

initial_liquidity.policy: fixed ex ante for all entities, independent of target; no replenishment

network_settings.N1: 3..12 distinct contributors; real transfer edges into one rotating collector; cash entry/exit
network_settings.N2: 3..12 distinct recipients; real transfer edges from rotating source; cash entry/exit
network_settings.N3: Complete cycles of 2..6 distinct wallets; independently varying edge amounts and intervals
network_settings.N4: One incoming transfer plus optional cash funding; 50..98% total funding onward in transfers/cash-out

nuisance_amounts.mixture: 75% truncated lognormal; 25% uniform shared high-value component; 35% rounded

phase_policy: first ceil(25%) early; last ceil(25%) late; remainder established
phase_roles: cash phases and real transfer edges; plans may overlap ordinary events; no label changes based on observations
routine_time_policy: Uniform within six 30-day blocks after wallet activation; no class-specific timestamp precision
scope_limitations: Baseline-relative effects are not feature-calibrated; no claim every generated pattern is detectable by the existing 30 features.
Wallet activity_band is metadata; routine wallet selection is uniform among active wallets.
Initial wallet and agent activation policy differs: agents are established, wallets include cold starts.
A4 uses an opening cash portion; it does not promise a whole-episode or whole-week dominant flow.

structuring_settings.S1: Gamma(0.8,1) unequal fragment composition; episode total USD300..60000 constrained by event cap; 25% chance of one continuation 1..3 days later
structuring_settings.S2: Shared anchor; 85% anchor-near draws; relative widths 0.015,0.04,0.07,0.20; other values from common support
structuring_settings.S3: Clustered intra-day fragments over 4..18h; 25% chance of repeats, at least six events/day, up to five days
structuring_settings.S4: Exactly ceil(25%)..floor(60%) near-threshold amounts per episode; common support elsewhere
